summary_1line: Ravana ascends through celestial regions to the Moon, attacks it in anger, and is stopped by Brahma who grants him a powerful protective mantra.

image_candidates.scene_text: Ravana in his flying chariot draws his bow and shoots blazing arrows upward at the radiant Moon surrounded by stars.
The many-headed Ravana ascends through layered heavens filled with clouds, Siddhas, Garuda, and the distant river of the sky.
Brahma appears before the furious Ravana in the lunar realm, raising a calming hand while the Moon shines coldly behind him.
